prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production TOP-DOWN FARM MAP BACKGROUND for a grid-based farm game, square 1024x1024. Reference image is ONLY for cozy sunlit forest colors, pixel cluster style, cream cottage teal solar roof identity; change camera to EXACT VERTICAL OVERHEAD orthographic map, north at top. NO horizon, sky, distant mountain elevations, visible building facades, tilted or isometric ground. Roofs and tree canopy tops only. Composition coordinates relative to1024 square: expansive QUIET EMPTY warm olive grass clearing occupies exact rectangle x128..896 y448..896 (width768 height448). ALL of this rectangle is reserved for 12x7 dynamic game cells; keep it completely unobstructed apart from tiny grass texture. Do NOT draw fields, crops, fences, rocks, bushes, paths, buildings or grid lines in that rectangle. Important this is reusable ground under dynamic user-arranged plots, not a painted full farm. In UPPER RIGHT service zone x610..900 y110..340, draw ONE cream farm cottage FROM ABOVE, teal gabled roof with six blue solar panels, chimney and right attached timber/log lean-to roofs, roof ridge aligned north-south, a few crate tops nearby, small pebbled doorstep only to south. Upper LEFT zone x170..500 y90..315 has small blue lake inlet with mossy irregular shoreline, ring of forest between water and farm clearing. Narrow tan service path along y365..412 connects north service area horizontally, then turns down the WEST outside board at x70..112 to bottom entrance. It never crosses reserved rectangle. Dense but not huge top-down mixed forest border: trunks hidden, round deciduous canopies with yellowgreen sunlight and dark teal conifer rosettes, along outermost top80px, left0..75, right950..1024, bottom950..1024; do not let canopies overhang reserved area. Small fern, stone and cream daisy clumps restricted to forest perimeter OUTSIDE rectangle. Clean connected irregular clearing, no straight cutout-looking foliage boundary, generous lawn around board. Match crisp hand-placed-looking hard-edged pixel art with medium square clusters, restrained detailed foliage, muted warm olive grass#a4ad65 #809a56, teal outline#263f3c, cream highlights#f0e4bb, lake#75bdd0. Upper-left sunlight as hard flat shade clusters. True transparent alpha outside irregular outer map silhouette only, opaque grass inside full playable clearing. No blur, gradients, glow, text, numbers, labels, icons, characters, robots, UI or visible grid. No tilted camera. No drawn farm plots. Entire image must feel like OVERHEAD version of reference's same secluded farm location.

Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit the just generated farm map, preserving its lake northwest, farm cottage northeast, north service path, west entrance path, sunny palette, texture, outer forest silhouette, and EMPTY lower meadow. ONE targeted correction: make the camera genuinely straight DOWN overhead everywhere. Redraw the cottage as roof ONLY: remove the south/front facade, door and wall windows from view; replace that small bottom-front facade strip with the overhead roof/eaves footprint and a little doorstep immediately south. Keep chimney top and six blue solar panels. Tree canopies should read as overhead crowns, especially conifers show branching rosettes, not standing side-view triangular tree silhouettes. All ground remains exactly north-up square. Critical preserve a completely UNOBSTRUCTED rectangle x128..896,y448..896 on a1024x1024 conceptual canvas; withdraw any bottom shrubs/canopies and right edge foliage that intrude into it. Tiny flat grass texture inside is fine, but no trees, rocks, path, buildings, fences or plots inside it. Keep building and all north scenery north of y420; west path left of x120; bottom forest below y920. Do not draw the reserved rectangle outline, grid, text or labels. Pixel art hard flat edges, no blur gradients glows. Transparent exterior only, opaque interior grass. Do not add any new objects. This must be a pure overhead map compatible with square tile dragging, not an oblique farm illustration.
